results.golden_answer:
The average weekly rent for 3-bedroom houses in postcode 2250 was $697 in the
latest month on record, May 2026, across 51 new bonds — a touch above April's
$692 and below March's $709. The figure is bond-weighted (total weekly rent
divided by the number of bonds), so it is one number for one month, not an
average of medians across bedroom bands.
results.label: high
results.golden_sql:
SELECT month,
       round(sum(total_weekly_rent) / NULLIF(sum(n_rented), 0), 2) AS avg_weekly_rent,
       sum(n_rented) AS n_rented
FROM marts.property_rent
WHERE postcode = '2250' AND property_type = 'house' AND bedroom_band = '3'
  AND month = (
    SELECT max(month) FROM marts.property_rent
    WHERE postcode = '2250' AND property_type = 'house' AND bedroom_band = '3'
  )
GROUP BY month
results.expectation: One number with its month — the bond-weighted average weekly rent (total_weekly_rent / n_rented) for 3-bedroom houses in postcode 2250 for the most recent month on record ($697.08 as at 2026-05-01).

results.answer: Dubbo led NSW house sales volume over the trailing 12 months, followed by Orange, Port Macquarie, Austral and Armidale.
results.sql_text:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT MAX(month) AS max_month FROM marts.property_sales
)
SELECT
  s.suburb,
  SUM(s.n_sold) AS n_sold,
  SUM(s.total_sale_value) AS total_sale_value
FROM marts.property_sales s, bounds b
WHERE s.property_type = 'house'
  AND s.month > (b.max_month - INTERVAL '12 months')
GROUP BY s.suburb
ORDER BY n_sold DESC

Over the 12 months to June 2026 the suburbs with the most house sales were Dubbo
(999), Orange (874), Port Macquarie (691), Austral (593) and Armidale (586). The
top of the list is regional: Dubbo and Orange alone account for more house
sales than any Sydney suburb, with Austral the only metropolitan entry, driven
by new-estate completions.
